notes.Nikola Jokic: He has played 36 to 39 minutes in three straight games, with 27 points, 11 rebounds and 8 assists Wednesday. New Orleans was just beaten by 31 by Memphis and played Friday without Dejounte Murray, who has asked for a trade; Denver is a 12.5-point favorite, so a blowout could trim his fourth quarter.
notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He scored 37 points with 9 rebounds in 31 minutes Friday against Cleveland and has played 31 to 34 minutes in each of his last four games. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and Miami has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Cade Cunningham: He played 48 minutes Thursday and scored 52 points with 11 assists for 81.75 DraftKings points. Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe are both ruled out tonight, so Detroit again leans on him for almost all of its creation.
notes.Cooper Flagg: He played only 27 minutes Thursday in a 39-point loss at Minnesota, after 39 minutes and 73 DraftKings points on Monday. Dereck Lively II is out again and Max Christie is questionable with an ankle sprain, so Dallas is thin up front and on the wing.
notes.Donovan Mitchell: He scored 25 points with 7 assists in 33 minutes Friday at Miami with Evan Mobley out. Mobley's coach called his toe sprain short-term, and Cleveland has not posted tonight's injury report yet.
notes.Jaylon Tyson: He moved into the starting five Friday with Evan Mobley out and played 30 minutes, scoring 16 points for 25.3 DraftKings points. If Mobley sits again tonight he should start; Cleveland has not posted its report yet.
notes.Kevin Huerter: Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe are both out tonight, which leaves Detroit short on shooting off the bench. He played 24 minutes Thursday with 11 points, and he had 35 minutes and 53.3 DraftKings points on Nov. 8.
notes.Meleek Thomas: He played 18 minutes off the bench Friday at Miami and scored 12 points, after 22 to 27 minutes in his three games before. His minutes depend partly on whether Evan Mobley plays, and Cleveland has not posted its report yet.
notes.Tyrese Proctor: He scored 22 points in 27 minutes off the bench Friday at Miami, his most minutes in his last four games, with Evan Mobley out. Cleveland has not posted tonight's report yet.
notes.Jordan Poole: Dejounte Murray has asked for a trade and did not play Friday, which keeps more guard minutes open. Poole played 21 minutes off the bench Friday with 13 points and 5 assists, but Denver is a 12.5-point favorite, so blowout risk is real.
notes.Jerami Grant: He scored 22 points off the bench in 26 minutes Friday but left with 7:36 to play after colliding with Herbert Jones on a drive. Memphis has not posted tonight's injury report yet, so check his status before lock.
notes.Trey Lyles: Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are both out again. Lyles played only 15 minutes Thursday and scored 2 DraftKings points in a 39-point win, after 29 minutes and 31.8 points on Nov. 6, so his role swings from night to night.
notes.Jaylen Wells: He has started every recent game and played 27 minutes Friday with 11 points. Memphis spread its minutes widely in Friday's 31-point win, with 10 players in double figures, so his ceiling is capped unless the game stays close.
notes.Jalen Smith: He had 15 points and 12 rebounds in 32 minutes Friday but bent back fingers on his left hand. He plans to try to play tonight at Minnesota; Chicago has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Norman Powell: He returned from back spasms Friday with no minutes limit and scored 33 points in 31 minutes, including 9 in overtime. Chicago played overtime last night and is on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Josh Giddey: He had 15 points, 10 rebounds and 14 assists in 39 minutes in Friday's overtime win. Chicago is a 14.5-point underdog at Minnesota on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Isaac Okoro: He started and played 41 minutes in Friday's overtime win, but scored only 25.8 DraftKings points in that time.
notes.Davion Mitchell: He had 22 points and a career-high-tying 17 assists in 39 minutes Friday against Cleveland and has played 38 to 40 minutes in three straight games.
notes.Bam Adebayo: He scored 37 points with 14 rebounds in 38 minutes Friday against Cleveland. Detroit is without Jalen Duren tonight, which weakens its size inside.
notes.Ryan Conwell: He played 33 minutes off the bench Friday and scored 20 points with Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) out. Miami has not posted whether either one returns tonight.
notes.Jarrett Allen: With Evan Mobley out Friday he played 32 minutes but managed only 9 points and 8 rebounds. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, so the matchup inside is softer tonight.
notes.Paul Reed: Jalen Duren is out again, and Reed played 38 minutes Thursday with 13 points and 11 rebounds.
notes.Saddiq Bey: He started Friday and scored 30 points with 10 rebounds in 35 minutes, the first Pelican to top 30 this season. New Orleans has not posted tonight's report yet.
notes.Ayo Dosunmu: Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are out again. Dosunmu has started every recent game, but he played only 27 minutes Thursday in a 39-point win.
notes.Max Christie: He is questionable tonight with a left ankle sprain. If he sits, Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher take more of the wing minutes.
notes.Zaccharie Risacher: He scored 22 points off the bench in 25 minutes Thursday, and Max Christie is questionable tonight with an ankle sprain, which could open more wing minutes.
He is questionable tonight with an illness and could miss a third straight game.
